text: Requiring community members to stake reputation tokens in order to validate data quality is what produces robust and reliable training datasets, and this participatory validation improves annotation accuracy while reducing bias.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How AI Models are Optimized Through Web3 Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4855607

isBasedOn.name: How AI Models are Optimized Through Web3 Governance

abstract: Community members stake reputation tokens to validate data quality, ensuring robust and reliable datasets for training AI models. This participatory approach can improve data annotation accuracy and reduce biases.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: training data validation carried out by a reputation staking community
